# CHAPTER 0 — THE PRE-SUNDERING COSMOS  
*Codified from your narration; gaps marked where you want insertable numbers or refinements*

Before Earth, before Tiamat, before Mars was scarred red, the local system wasn’t a “solar system.”  
It was a Graviton-managed lattice of half-materialized worlds:

- Neptune (proto-form)  
- Mars (green-world seed)  
- Saturn (central node)  
- Pluto (outer anchor)  
- Several unnamed Gambit-substrates — proto-planetoids in flux

These worlds weren’t “planets” the way we know them.  
They were multi-existent bodies, partially in:

1. baseline matter  
2. void-space  
3. a pre-ethereal phase-state the Gravitons alone understood

This is why the Void Spiers worked.  
They were built across all three layers simultaneously.
The Gravitons erected Void Spiers on every planetary candidate they planned to solidify.
A Void Spire was:

- not fully 3D  
- not fully void  
- not fully ethereal  
- but anchored to all three

They were interstellar elevators before “space” even stabilized.  
You didn’t fly between worlds — you shifted between layers of existence.
The Gravitons intended them as colony highways for when the system finished “cohering.”
It never got that far.
The Gravitons built the infrastructure but didn’t finish the job.
Chaos multiplied faster than they could regulate it.
So another faction stepped forward:

**The Aeon Keepers**  
Not creators.  
Not gods.  
Archivists of equilibrium.
They took:

- raw chaos  
- raw void
…and crushed it into **vrill** through compression rituals older than memory.
Vrill is what allowed:

- stability  
- predictability  
- sequence  
- cause and effect  
- entangled co-realities to stop collapsing
With vrill, the Aeon Keepers forged **The Veil** — a membrane between:

1. Material  
2. Ethereal  
3. Void
…and this triad produced the **Ethereal Realm** as a stable overlay.
> This is the true beginning of magic as a system.
Your cosmology isn’t binary. It’s tetradic:

- **The Veil** (membrane)  
- **The Ethereal** (reflection)  
- **The Void** (absence)  
- **Vrill** (condensed pattern-energy)

Four denominations.  
Four currencies.  
Four conflicts.

The Aeon Keepers maintained balance.  
The Gravitons maintained infrastructure.
And then the Gravitons walked off the stage.

The Gravitons never incarnated into biological humanoids.  
They were always “adjacent beings” — present but unfixed.
Yet humanoid forms did exist in the system in this era.
When the Gravitons saw the chaos cycles spiraling out of regulation, they left.
They took:

- their archives  
- their keys  
- and **Saturn** itself, their central node
The moment Saturn vanished:

- The lattice collapsed  
- Light sequences destabilized  
- The local system dimmed  
- “The Darkness” moved in to reclaim the region
This was the first cosmic blackout.
> Later cultures would call it “The Sundering Before the Sundering.”
The **Temporal Agency** already existed — a multi-realm organization monitoring:

- parallel timelines  
- coexistent layers  
- branching futures  
- vrill patterns  
- collapses
When the Gravitons departed, reality began fraying.

The Temporal Agency synthesized the **Veyronic Pattern**  
(*check your final name: Veyronic / Vayronic / Vehronic / Veironic*)  
—a stabilizing temporal lattice that can:

- hold open portals  
- synchronize divergent timelines  
- resist entropy

This is the knowledge the Queen wanted.  
This is the pattern the Temporal Guardian protected.
The **Annunaki** arrived immediately, like wolves scenting blood.
While the Gravitons ignored the threat, the Annunaki did not.
They wanted:

- the Pattern  
- the timing keys  
- dominion over the Veil
They chased the **Temporal Guardian**, leader of the Agency, across collapsing timelines.
As the Void Spiers shut down one by one, he used the Veyronic Pattern to:

- hold the last gate open  
- evacuate his colony  
- deny the Queen access  
- jump through the collapsing gate

But the jump fractured him:  
He split into three temporal shards, scattered across space and time.
> This is the **Viên-triad** precursor.
The Queen unleashed **The Blood Curse** afterward — a recursive hunting mechanism locked to his signature.
With the Gravitons gone and the Temporal Guardian missing, the Aeon Keepers stepped up.
They built the **Akashic Library**.

Not a metaphor.  
Not a storage device.  
A living multidimensional recorder that:

- maps reality  
- logs timeline collapses  
- stores planetary history from the moment it forms  
- stabilizes vrill  
- interfaces with Nehereti conduits
They became not just keepers of balance — they became the **memory of the galaxy**.
This is the lost era you’re trying to lock numbers into.
The Queen entered a cyclical orbit around the proto-galaxy.

**Why?**  
To map:

- planetary drift  
- void tides  
- vrill upwellings  
- star alignments  
- ethereal ripples  
- debris flows  
- potential colony seeds

But the duration is unknown.  
This is the **Blank Record Period** in the Akashic Library.
> *(insert years_or_cycles_unk_here)*
This is intentional — it creates mythic uncertainty.

Eventually the Aeon Keepers grew tired of being archivists.  
They wanted life, not logs.
Using:

- samples from green-world Mars  
- their own thought-forms  
- vrill as scaffolding
…they created:

- **Tiamat** — the water planet  
- **The Nehereti** — light/dark friction beings  
- **The Pelagor** — ancient aquatic organics
This event marks the **first official entry in the Akashic Library**.
> *(insert first_documented_year_here)*
This era was peaceful.
Until the Queen made her move.
The Queen finally maneuvered her influence into place.
Enter **Marduk**, carrying one of his shepherd moons.

- Impact  
- Shattering  
- Tiamat dies  
- Earth is born  
- The debris becomes the Asteroid Belt  
- Mars is wounded and bleeds its atmosphere  
- The old vrill flows rupture  
- The Akashic Library surges  
- The Nehereti flee  
- The Galaxy enters the first true **Dawn of War**
And that’s where your known history begins.
